access: Who may see or change an occasion: membership, roles, the finance and private-request grants, business-team access. Every occasion read starts here.
accounts: The signed-in person's account: profile, display name, fresh sign-in check for sensitive actions, account deletion and purge.
aitext: AI wording suggestions for invitations and messages: provider seam, 10-per-month limit, nothing applied without the user accepting.
all: Imports every core module so all import-time registrations exist in every process (web, worker, tests).
approvals: Second-person approvals for irreversible staff actions; single-operator mode queues them.
arrangementkit: Pure, client-safe helpers for the flower arrangement designer: forms, sketch layout, indicative cost, version diff.
arrangements: Flower arrangement designs and their versions, quote requests from a design, the arrangement What-if kind.
audit: Writes one append-only audit row for a state change. Call it from every mutation.
auditview: Staff-only reading and CSV export of the audit log. There is no way to change audit rows.
billing: Dormant billing: Stripe test-mode client, signed webhook handling, subscriptions, grace and lapse, refunds, prices. Refuses everything while monetisation is off.
bizoccasions: Occasions owned by a business: creation, team access settings, branding shown to guests, business reports.
bookings: A supplier booking's state, agreed amount, quote file and its recorded transitions.
briefingpdf: The downloadable occasion briefing PDF and the shared PDF toolkit (fonts, colours, margins) other PDFs reuse.
briefings: Immutable supplier briefing versions, what changed between them, and the supplier's acknowledgement through a scoped link.
budget: Budget by category with five separate amounts (estimate, committed, invoiced, paid, forecast); requires the finance grant.
business: Business accounts and their team: membership, roles, status, lapse helpers, factual badges, notices.
capacity: The one shared count of places for an occasion; atomic claim, adjust and release so two people cannot take the last place.
catalogues: Flower catalogues a business publishes (through moderation) and the public read API for them.
checkin: Arrivals on the day: QR or name check-in, corrections with a reason, guest-flow counts and projection.
claims: A business claiming an unclaimed directory listing: emailed code or moderator check, then second-person approval.
closeout: Cancel, postpone and close an occasion through previews; closeout list; lessons carried to the next occasion.
comms: Staff notices to businesses only; never to planner-entered contacts.
compliance: Launch checklist, legal-document publication gate for sign-up, launch records.
complianceaccess: Time-boxed, three-person-approved staff access to one person's records, and the data-subject export.
context: The request context every core function receives (database, actor, time, locale) and the actor types.
contributions: "Who brings what": needs with quantities and atomic claims by guests and members.
cookies: The exact set of three cookies the app uses and its signature for the cookie notice. Client-safe.
corrections: Records a correction to a fact (payment, received quantity, arrival) with before, after, who and why.
delegations: Offering a task to someone; accept or decline with a reason; a decline returns the task to the delegator.
deletion: Generic deletion requests with a seven-day undo, used by accounts and occasions.
deliveries: Deliveries, hired items and returns; received quantities are facts changed only by correction.
deploys: Staff deploy requests: tag and CI checks, second-person approval, dispatch to GitHub, recorded stages and rollbacks.
digest: The daily digest email per member, with sections other domains register.
directory: The public directory: search results, daily organic rotation that cannot be bought, public listing view, task-to-directory links.
discovery: Finding businesses from public sources into moderated, unclaimed listings; one claim invitation; removal and objection handling.
drawings: Venue spaces per listing: drawing upload, two-point calibration, markings in real millimetres, parking facts, moderated versions.
enquiries: Planner-to-business enquiries and quote requests: what is shared, limits, thread states, the 48-hour nudge, accepting a quote.
eventday: The event-day view over the same task rows: four states, the one "now" item, times of day.
expenses: Expenses with receipts; approval and payment are independent; a paid expense changes only by correction.
exports: Registry and runner for CSV/PDF exports shown on the print page; CSV escaping.
featured: Paid placement slots. Returns nothing while monetisation is off; never changes organic order.
fetching: robots.txt checking for outbound discovery fetches.
fitcheck: Pure fit check of a room plan: seats, area, aisles; unknown dimensions are excluded, never counted as fitting.
geography: Counties, localities and directory categories: lookups for forms and staff management.
gifts: The private gift estimator for a planner; visible to that account only, never exported.
guestevent: What a guest sees about the event: page URL, navigation link, the accessible-journey facts.
guestimport: Importing a guest list from CSV or XLSX through a preview, with duplicate detection and size limits.
guests: Households and named adult guests; children are only ever a count. Guest list export.
handover: Handing a business-owned occasion to the client: ownership moves and all business-side access ends.
idempotency: Runs a mutation once per key so a double tap or retry does not apply twice.
incidents: The plain-language incident message shown on guest-facing pages.
invitations: Guest links: token hashing, expiry, revocation, the guest's own view, guest-page sections other domains register.
invitationtext: Custom invitation wording, including proposals from an external assistant.
invoicing: Fiscal invoicing seam (sandbox provider only) and its webhook handling.
itinerary: Trip legs across time zones and importing bookings from pasted text or .ics through a preview.
ledger: The shared-cost ledger: who paid, who benefits, balances that sum to zero per currency, settlement.
library: A business's reusable templates, checklists, supplier contacts and files, applied to its occasions.
lifecycle: Registries for cancel/postpone impact rows and closeout sections; the closed-occasion write guard.
listings: Business listings: drafts, validation against fixed categories and places, submission, unclaimed listings, suspension.
listingstats: Response statistics shown on a listing, published only above a threshold and never affected by payment.
members: Occasion team: invitations by email, roles, grants, removal, ownership transfer.
menus: Menus, guests' meal choices as counts, food and drink quantities, pushing them into a supplier order.
moderation: The single moderation queue for listings, drawings, catalogues and parking facts; the live version stays up while a change waits.
monetization: The monetisation switch (off by default), its approvals, notice period and the permanent free tier.
occasions: Occasions themselves: create, edit, move the date through a preview, delete with undo, purge.
offline: Offline capture of arrivals and own checklist ticks, reconciled once on reconnect; conflicts are never merged silently.
orders: Final-order snapshots per booking and the deltas when replies change afterwards.
overview: The occasion overview: next milestone, overdue work, unaccepted delegations, blockers, plus registered sections.
packing: Packing lists, stored as task checklists.
payments: Supplier payment deadlines (finance grant), paid facts, the move-payment preview, booking money for the budget.
plannotes: Planner-side notes created from assistant proposals: supplier shortlists and budget notes.
polls: Date polls: candidate dates, household votes, confirming a date. Votes never reserve places.
printpack: Print-ready PDFs: QR labels, QR invitations, table cards, to-scale room plan.
programme: The programme of the day, versioned cue lists, performer briefings, one notification per guest-visible change.
promotion: Generated copy, image cards, calendar file and poster to download. Nothing is posted or spent.
publicpage: The public event page settings and lookup, with conditional registration questions.
qr: Stable QR ids for invitations, resolving a QR to the guest's own view, drawing QR codes.
ratelimit: Rate limits on three axes (email, IP, device), the public-form bot guard, the security log and its retention.
readiness: Hold / proceed / proceed-with-conditions decisions, each with evidence.
registrations: Public registrations for an event, the waiting list and its atomic promotion.
rehearsal: Read-only simulation of the day from registered timeline sources, with conflicts in words.
reports: Content reports (notice and action): intake, review, decision and the reason given to the affected party.
requests: Private dietary and access requests, visible only with the private-requests grant; purged after closeout.
retention: Registry and runner for retention (purge) rules.
rooms: Rooms and room assignments for trips, with atomic capacity.
rsvp: Household replies, custom questions and answers, counts summary; a reply claims places atomically.
seating: The occasion's space model, tables, seat assignments, meal stages, publishing seats to guests, seating What-if kinds.
spacemodel: Pure, client-safe room plan model: geometry, calibration maths, rendering a plan to SVG.
staff: Staff members, roles, console access (needs two-step), dashboard counters, audited settings.
stationery: Invitation and stationery versions, the proof gate before a print PDF, digital invitation style.
stationerykit: The eight stationery designs as data and the layout engine that draws the same thing to SVG and PDF. Server only.
stats: Daily counters without visitor identifiers and the nightly collectors.
subgroups: Trip subgroups, optional activities with atomic places, participant settlement view.
suppliers: Suppliers in a plan, the scoped supplier link, linking a directory listing to a supplier and booking.
sustainability: Optional sustainability goals with measured values; unknown never counts as meeting a goal.
tasks: Tasks: one query behind the list, board and calendar views; status, checklists, dependencies.
tasks-proposals: A task list proposed by an external assistant, applied only when the planner confirms.
templates: Occasion templates with due dates relative to the occasion date, re-run as a diff; day helpers.
transport: Transport legs for trips with atomic seat claims.
tx: Runs a function inside a database transaction with a context bound to it.
whatif: The What-if engine: create a preview, confirm applies it once, discard changes nothing.
wiring: Glue between domains that must not import each other: enquiry counts for business reports and the console.
wiring-programme: Glue: feeds the programme into the rehearsal timeline.
